title: 第9章 你这知识都学杂了啊！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
察觉到男人的注视，李清妍转过头，神色淡然地回望着对方。

    大学的时候，两人之间并无过多的交集，但相比其他班上男生，梁惟石给她的印象还算是比较深的。

    不是因为梁惟石个子高，长得帅，而是因为对方打架很厉害。

    有一次系里组织看电影，电影院有群社会混子见色起意调戏班里女同学，男生们上前阻拦，并于互相推掇之间爆发了混战，辅导员见情况不对立刻打电话报警。

    等附近警察赶到现场时发现，学生们差不多都是皮外伤，反倒有几个混混躺在地上哼哼呀呀似乎伤得很重的样子，而剩下的同伙正用震惊和仇视的目光瞪着一个男学生。

    这个男学生，就是梁惟石。

    没错，几个被打翻在地的混混，全是梁惟石下的黑手。

    她当时看得很清楚，这家伙又是躺刀摔，又是顶心肘，又是撩阴脚，又是膝撞头，此外还有标指戳喉，和终结技大逼兜！

    警察叔叔一边察看混混们的伤势，一边嘴角直抽抽。

    带队的副队长还一个劲儿地追问梁惟石是不是练过……

    梁惟石坦然迎着李清妍带有询问意味的目光，微笑说道：“你这次帮了我大忙，为了表示感谢，我请你喝杯刨冰怎么样？”

    李清妍唇角轻轻一挑回问道：“你现在身价过百万，就请一杯刨冰是不是有点儿小气了？”

    梁惟石摇了摇头说道：“和小气无关，主要是老同学你人美心善，不会让我花太多的钱。甚至，连一杯刨冰，老同学可能都在考虑要不要赏脸！”

    李清妍眼中闪过一抹诧异之色。

    因为她的想法竟然被对方看穿了。

    实际上她并不需要什么感谢，尤其是物质上的感谢，她之所以选择帮忙，是因为大家同学一场，是因为她对梁惟石印象还行，是因为她拿梁惟石当了‘挡箭牌’。

    面对异性的单独邀约，她向来都是婉言拒绝，哪怕梁惟石只是想请她喝杯冷饮，她也准备采取这种轻松得体的玩笑方式不着痕迹的推脱掉。

    “怎么感觉，你很了解我似的？”李清妍沉默了一下，然后似笑非笑地问了一句。

    梁惟石微微一笑回道：“那倒没有，主要是我会看相，一看就知道老同学是那种心地善良爱为他人着想的性格。”
content_en:
Sensing the man's gaze, Li Qingyan turned her head and looked back at him with an indifferent expression.

When they were in college, they didn't have much interaction with each other, but compared to other boys in the class, Liang Weishi left a relatively deep impression on her.

It's not because Liang Weishi is tall and handsome, but because the opponent is very good at fighting.

One time, the department organized a movie viewing. A group of gangsters in the movie theater wanted to molest the female classmates in the class. The boys stepped forward to stop them, and a scuffle broke out among them, pushing each other. The counselor immediately called the police when he saw something was wrong.

When the nearby police arrived at the scene, they found that most of the students had superficial injuries. On the contrary, a few gangsters were lying on the ground groaning and seemed to be seriously injured, while the remaining gangsters were staring at a male student with shock and hatred.

This male student is Liang Weishi.

That's right, the few gangsters who were knocked to the ground were all the masterminds of Liang Weishi.

She could see clearly at that time that this guy was throwing on his back, elbowing, touching his vaginal feet, and hitting his head with his knees. In addition, he was stabbing his throat with his index finger, and his finishing move was the big cock!

The policeman's mouth twitched while inspecting the gangsters' injuries.

The vice-captain leading the team kept asking Liang Weishi if he had practiced...

Liang Weishi calmly met Li Qingyan's questioning gaze and said with a smile: "You helped me a lot this time. To express my gratitude, how about I treat you to a cup of shaved ice?"

Li Qingyan raised the corners of her lips and asked, "You are worth over a million now, so isn't it a bit stingy to just buy you a cup of shaved ice?"

Liang Weishi shook his head and said: "It has nothing to do with being stingy. The main reason is that you, my old classmate, are kind-hearted and won't let me spend too much money. Even for a cup of shaved ice, my old classmate may be thinking about whether to reward you!"

A look of surprise flashed in Li Qingyan's eyes.

Because her thoughts were actually seen through by the other party.

In fact, she didn't need any thanks, especially material ones. The reason why she chose to help was because we were classmates, because she had a good impression of Liang Weishi, and because she used Liang Weishi as a 'shield'.

She always declined politely when facing individual invitations from the opposite sex. Even if Liang Weishi just wanted to buy her a cold drink, she was prepared to use this relaxed and decent joke method to get rid of the invitation without leaving any trace.

"How do you feel, you know me very well?" Li Qingyan was silent for a moment, and then asked with a half-smile.

Liang Weishi smiled slightly and replied: "That's not true. The main reason is that I can read faces. I can tell at a glance that my old classmate is the kind-hearted person who loves to think about others."
